name: University of Newcastle Indigenous Education Scholarship
summary: Commonwealth-funded education costs scholarship for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander UON students in financial hardship.
key: A total benefit of up to $3000, paid in two equal instalments of $1500.
who: Enrolled or enrolling in an enabling, undergraduate or postgraduate program
Of Australian Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander descent
Able to show financial hardship, for example through a means-tested Commonwealth income support payment
how: Apply through the online portal (PDF uploads only)

source.label: University of Newcastle: Indigenous Education Scholarship

evidence.quote: Offers a total benefit of up to $3000 paid in two equal instalments of $1500 following the Semester 1 and 2 census dates.
Be of Australian Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander descent
Demonstrate financial hardship by either being in receipt of a means-tested Commonwealth income support payment
